 Print Bank of India SO admit card 2026 : Bank of India (BOI) has released the admit card for the Specialist Officer (SO) recruitment examination 2026. Candidates who have registered for the recruitment drive can now access and download their call letters through the official website, bankofindia.co.in. The online examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 27, 2026. The admit card is a mandatory document for appearing in the computer-based test (CBT). Candidates will not be permitted to enter the examination centre without a valid hall ticket. Applicants must download the document in advance and verify all the details mentioned on it to avoid last-minute complications. Join conversation

 The recruitment drive, under Project No. 2026-27/02, aims to fill 205 Specialist Officer vacancies across Scale I, II, III and IV. Candidates will need their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth to access the admit card through the designated IBPS portal. Bank of India SO admit card 2026: Steps to download hall ticket
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the Bank of India SO admit card 2026 on the official website: Visit the official website of Bank of India at bankofindia.co.in.
 Navigate to the 'Careers' section on the homepage.
 Open the recruitment section and locate the Specialist Officer recruitment notification for Project No. 2026-27/02.
 Click on the link provided for the SO admit card or call letter.
 You will be redirected to the designated IBPS login portal.
 Enter your registration number or roll number and password or date of birth.
 Enter the security code or captcha, wherever required.
 Click on the submit or login option.
 The BOI SO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check the particulars mentioned on the call letter and download the PDF.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the Bank of India SO admit card 2026. Aspirants are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the BOI recruitment process.
